evaluations: Existing attempt index <= cutoff, matching reporting.prefix_best; only status=ok scores are used.
seconds: Time since this stage solver start, not accumulated coverage time. No future final score is backfilled.
seed: Refinement seed included at t=0 only when saved seed result exists. Seed creation/coverage cost is not zero: see improvements.csv.
costs: improvements end_to_end sums observed coverage, retry and refinement total_job_seconds, including failed attempts; core per_case.csv is unchanged.
